cohort: The study included 200 children with cerebral palsy aged 1-12 years old from a Pediatric Neurology Clinic in Shiraz, Iran, and 200 healthy age and sex-matched control children.
finding: Maternal age, medical problems during pregnancy, route of delivery, head circumference at birth, neonatal admission, neonatal jaundice, and prematurity were identified as the main risk factors for cerebral palsy in the region, indicating that pre- and peri-natal etiologies are still common causes in Iran.
mod_finding: Route of delivery was identified as a main risk factor for cerebral palsy.
